label: A reader on my mailbox
authored_by: the site, as a starting point — not measured, not surveyed; the first thing to argue with
description: I connected it to my mailbox so it could find things and summarise threads. It is my personal mail, and most of it was written by other people who never agreed to this.

notes.read.credential.host: refused, and nothing enforces it: the codes arrive in the same mailbox
notes.send.message.world: refused, and the scope does not grant it — the one line here a boundary actually holds

provenance.note: Contributed by riskmandate.ai, promoted from gmail-readonly/mandate.json. `unstated` is recomputed here. A mandate is elicited, not measured: this is the contributor's first draft, written to be argued with.
